verdict_text:
STATIC delta verdict: no blocking code/schema mismatch found in the three adapter02 originals.

- freeze.py and BINDING.schema.json match on all three literal roots and the exact ordered 1 + 2 + 7 = 10 directory names. Every external-tree item requires the list; other roots require [].
- inventory(..., *, empty_directories=()) retains a strict default. Declared empties undergo normalized-path, physical-directory, true-emptiness, collision/ancestor, exact-membership and rich-stat recording checks. They are not pruned or included as manifest files.
- Both external-tree passes use the same checks, and complete before/after inventory equality remains unchanged.
- Author, A, Round0, frozen-output and Markdown directory-link call sites remain strict. The 17 acceptance roles, author32, dynamic A membership, host boundary, isolated interpreter flags and native operations are untouched.
- Recorder changes are confined to the new allowlist, inventory, verify_external_trees, PREPARATION, and the v2 binding identifier. The pending template remains explicitly disabled.

Non-blocking format note: declared_empty_directories: [] is now returned for strict inventories too; this adds an output field but does not relax directory membership.

This verdict covers source inspection only—not execution, schema-validation tests, binding completeness, filesystem-state acceptance, or manuscript review. No files were written; neither recorder was imported or run.
